args.title: Fix currency-based row merging bug in src/export/csv.ts
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The current implementation of writeCsv merges rows by content but does not consider the currency field as part of the key for unique rows. This causes rows with the same date, amount and description but different currencies to be merged incorrectly, resulting in missing rows in the exported CSV.

The change needed is to update the CSV writing logic to ensure that the currency is included in the criteria that distinguishes unique rows, so rows differing only by currency do not get merged.
